description: This file defines macros, inline functions, and constants for controlling and interfacing with the Intel DSP Core Watchdog Timer within the Zephyr RTOS environment. It includes register offsets, control bits, and functions to pause, resume, and configure the watchdog timer for specific cores.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_pause
methods.description: Sets the pause signal to stop the watchdog timer for a specific core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_resume
methods.description: Clears the pause signal to resume the watchdog timer for a specific core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_reset_set
methods.description: Enables or disables the second timeout reset for a specific core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_pointer_get
methods.description: Retrieves the watchdog IP pointer for a specific core.

methods.name: intel_adsp_wdt_version_get
methods.description: Retrieves the watchdog IP version for a specific core.
